name: Edge-honest electronic baseline (A3): 4 cores / 1.4 GHz / 16x16 INT8 / 4 MB / 64 GB/s LPDDR5X-class
_provenance:
Edge-honest revision of A2. Each change is sourced or derived, and each was sensitivity-tested first:/n  global_buffer_MB 25 -> 4 : Coral Edge TPU has 8 MB on-chip SRAM; measured: 2..25 MB does NOT change latency.
  global_buffer_bandwidth_per_cycle_byte 183 -> 32 (256 -> 44.8 GB/s) : a 16x16 INT8 array needs two operand streams per cycle (16 B weights + 16 B activations) = 32 B/cycle. THIS PARAMETER IS ON THE CRITICAL PATH (sensitivity: 45 GB/s -> 28.53 us vs 256 GB/s -> 16.56 us on the stem shape, -59%).
  DRAM structure 1ch x 64pin -> 4ch x 16pin at the same 64 GB/s : Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 and Apple A18 Pro both use 4x16-bit LPDDR5X. Measured: structure change alone does NOT change latency at equal aggregate bandwidth.
  total_capacity_GB 16 -> 8 : Apple A18 Pro ships 8 GB.
  process_node 7nm -> 4nm : Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 is TSMC N4P.
  SRAM_KB 192 -> 64 : mobile NPU scale; measured: 64/128/192 KB does NOT change latency.
  interconnect: NVLink3 inheritance removed (no mobile SoC uses NVLink; unused at device_count=1).
KEPT as specified by the user: 4 cores, 1.4 GHz, 16x16 INT8. Peak = 4*16*16*1.4GHz*2 = 2.87 TOPS INT8, i.e. entry-edge class (Coral Edge TPU = 4 TOPS), well below flagship mobile NPUs (35-50 TOPS).
